name: AU Small Finance Bank Limited
summary: AU Small Finance Bank Limited provides various banking and financial services in India. The company operates through Treasury, Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. It offers savings, NRI, corporate salary, senior citizen, women and family, minor, current, premium banking, special offerings, RERA and escrow, collection, share capital and dividend, EXIM, institution current, government banking, Forex, SNRR, and grouping of business and personal accounts; and fixed, recurring, FCNR, and green fixed deposits.
